datasets.name: f47a6fb2
queryLines:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT 'Warehouse idle time' AS source_label, workspace_id, warehouse_id AS entity_id, 'warehouse' AS entity_kind,
         status, ROUND(est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2) AS wasted, est_wasted_usd_list AS floor_value, window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_warehouse_idle_minutes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Idle cluster nodes', dc.workspace_id, w.cluster_id, 'cluster',
         w.status, ROUND(w.est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2), w.est_wasted_usd_list, w.window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_idle_node_ratio w
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_cluster dc ON dc.cluster_id = w.cluster_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Compute burned on failed runs', workspace_id, job_id, 'job',
         status, ROUND(est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE), window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.lakeflow_failed_jobs_wasted_dbus
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Compute burned on failed statements', workspace_id, warehouse_id, 'warehouse',
         status, ROUND(est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2), est_wasted_usd_list, window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_failed_statement_waste
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Endpoints billed with no requests', workspace_id, endpoint_id, 'endpoint',
         status, ROUND(est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2), est_usd_list, window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_serving_endpoint_cost_status
),
eff AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN') AND floor_value IS NOT NULL
                   AND floor_value < 50.0 * window_days / 30.0
              THEN 'OK' ELSE status END AS eff_status
  FROM src
),
named_all AS (
  SELECT e.*, COALESCE(ws.name, e.workspace_id, 'Account-level') AS workspace_name
  FROM eff e
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace ws ON ws.workspace_id = e.workspace_id
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT source_label, workspace_id, entity_id, entity_kind, wasted
  FROM eff
  WHERE eff_status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN') AND wasted > 0
),
named AS (
  SELECT f.source_label, f.entity_kind, f.wasted,
         COALESCE(ws.name, f.workspace_id, 'Account-level') AS workspace_name,
         COALESCE(dw.warehouse_name, dc.cluster_name, dj.name, ep.endpoint_name, f.entity_id) AS resource_name
  FROM flagged f
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace ws ON ws.workspace_id = f.workspace_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse dw ON f.entity_kind = 'warehouse' AND dw.warehouse_id = f.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_cluster dc ON f.entity_kind = 'cluster' AND dc.cluster_id = f.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_job dj ON f.entity_kind = 'job' AND dj.workspace_id = f.workspace_id AND dj.job_id = f.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_serving_endpoint_cost_status ep
    ON f.entity_kind = 'endpoint' AND ep.workspace_id = f.workspace_id AND ep.endpoint_id = f.entity_id
)
,
named_ws AS (
  SELECT *, workspace_name AS ws_name FROM named
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(wasted), 0), 0) AS value,
       concat(CAST(count(*) AS STRING), ' resources flagged') AS target
FROM named_ws
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))

),
flagged AS (

),
named AS (

,
named_ws AS (

)

queryLines:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT m.*, COALESCE(dw.warehouse_name, m.warehouse_id) AS resource_name,
         COALESCE(ws.name, m.workspace_id, 'Account-level') AS workspace_name
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_warehouse_idle_minutes m
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse dw ON dw.warehouse_id = m.warehouse_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace ws ON ws.workspace_id = m.workspace_id
),
autostop AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN warehouse_kind = 'serverless' THEN 1 ELSE 10 END AS target_minutes,
         CASE WHEN warehouse_kind = 'serverless' THEN autostop_1_idle_minutes ELSE autostop_10_idle_minutes END AS target_idle_minutes,
         CASE WHEN warehouse_kind = 'serverless' THEN autostop_1_cold_starts ELSE autostop_10_cold_starts END AS target_cold_starts
  FROM w
),
saving AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN auto_stop_minutes IS NOT NULL AND (auto_stop_minutes = 0 OR auto_stop_minutes > target_minutes)
                   AND autostop_now_idle_minutes IS NOT NULL AND target_idle_minutes IS NOT NULL
                   AND usd_per_cluster_minute IS NOT NULL
              THEN ROUND((autostop_now_idle_minutes - target_idle_minutes) * usd_per_cluster_minute * (1.0 - 0.0), 2)
         END AS saving_usd,
         GREATEST(COALESCE(target_cold_starts, 0) - COALESCE(autostop_now_cold_starts, 0), 0) AS extra_cold_starts
  FROM autostop
)
,
saving_ws AS (
  SELECT *, workspace_name AS ws_name FROM saving
)
SELECT CASE WHEN workspace_name IS NULL THEN resource_name ELSE concat(resource_name, ' · ', workspace_name) END AS warehouse,
       ROUND(SUM(saving_usd), 0) AS usd
FROM saving_ws
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND saving_usd > 0
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

queryLines:
SELECT lbl_warehouse AS warehouse, ROUND(MAX(avg_read_io_cache_percent), 0) AS pct
FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_warehouse, COALESCE(concat(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS n_warehouse, COALESCE(d_wn.n, d_wv.workspace_id) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_wn.n, d_wv.workspace_id) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_wn.n, d_wv.workspace_id)) END AS lbl_warehouse FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_warehouse_cache_reuse t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) d_warehouse ON d_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS k, max(workspace_id) AS workspace_id FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY 1) d_wv ON d_wv.k = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY 1) d_wn ON d_wn.workspace_id = d_wv.workspace_id)
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND avg_read_io_cache_percent IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 8

datasets.name: ebdedd09
queryLines:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT 'Warehouse idle time' AS source_label, workspace_id, warehouse_id AS entity_id, 'warehouse' AS entity_kind,
         status, ROUND(est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2) AS wasted, est_wasted_usd_list AS floor_value, window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_warehouse_idle_minutes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Idle cluster nodes', dc.workspace_id, w.cluster_id, 'cluster',
         w.status, ROUND(w.est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2), w.est_wasted_usd_list, w.window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_idle_node_ratio w
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_cluster dc ON dc.cluster_id = w.cluster_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Compute burned on failed runs', workspace_id, job_id, 'job',
         status, ROUND(est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE), window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.lakeflow_failed_jobs_wasted_dbus
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Compute burned on failed statements', workspace_id, warehouse_id, 'warehouse',
         status, ROUND(est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2), est_wasted_usd_list, window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_failed_statement_waste
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Endpoints billed with no requests', workspace_id, endpoint_id, 'endpoint',
         status, ROUND(est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2), est_usd_list, window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_serving_endpoint_cost_status
),
eff AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN') AND floor_value IS NOT NULL
                   AND floor_value < 50.0 * window_days / 30.0
              THEN 'OK' ELSE status END AS eff_status
  FROM src
),
named_all AS (
  SELECT e.*, COALESCE(ws.name, e.workspace_id, 'Account-level') AS workspace_name
  FROM eff e
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace ws ON ws.workspace_id = e.workspace_id
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT source_label, workspace_id, entity_id, entity_kind, wasted
  FROM eff
  WHERE eff_status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN') AND wasted > 0
),
named AS (
  SELECT f.source_label, f.entity_kind, f.wasted,
         COALESCE(ws.name, f.workspace_id, 'Account-level') AS workspace_name,
         COALESCE(dw.warehouse_name, dc.cluster_name, dj.name, ep.endpoint_name, f.entity_id) AS resource_name
  FROM flagged f
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace ws ON ws.workspace_id = f.workspace_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse dw ON f.entity_kind = 'warehouse' AND dw.warehouse_id = f.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_cluster dc ON f.entity_kind = 'cluster' AND dc.cluster_id = f.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_job dj ON f.entity_kind = 'job' AND dj.workspace_id = f.workspace_id AND dj.job_id = f.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_serving_endpoint_cost_status ep
    ON f.entity_kind = 'endpoint' AND ep.workspace_id = f.workspace_id AND ep.endpoint_id = f.entity_id
)
,
named_ws AS (
  SELECT *, workspace_name AS ws_name FROM named
)
SELECT source_label AS source, resource_name AS resource, workspace_name AS workspace,
       CASE entity_kind WHEN 'warehouse' THEN 'SQL warehouse' WHEN 'cluster' THEN 'Cluster'
                         WHEN 'job' THEN 'Job' WHEN 'endpoint' THEN 'Serving endpoint' ELSE entity_kind END AS kind,
       ROUND(wasted, 2) AS possible_usd
FROM named_ws
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
ORDER BY wasted DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH checks AS (

         CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'

              WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
              WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
              WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
              WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'

         COALESCE(l.critical, 0) AS critical_rows, COALESCE(l.warn, 0) AS warn_rows
  FROM checks c
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
)

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM status WHERE verdict IN ('Critical', 'Warn')) AS value,
       COALESCE(
         (SELECT concat('Worst: ', check_title) FROM status WHERE verdict = 'Critical' ORDER BY critical_rows DESC LIMIT 1),
         (SELECT concat('Worst: ', check_title) FROM status WHERE verdict = 'Warn' ORDER BY warn_rows DESC LIMIT 1),
         'Nothing flagged') AS target

Each source below is a check that already runs on its own home tab -- nothing here is a separate measurement.
A check counts toward the priced total only when its own rows carry a possible-waste dollar column, the one column this app treats as recoverable waste. A check with no dollar column ranks by how many rows it flags instead (Flagged, not priced).

frame.title: Priced sources
frame.description: The 5 checks whose own rows carry a possible-waste $ column; their totals are on Priced.

frame.title: Flagged, no dollar figure
frame.description: Checks that flag rows but have no $ column; ranked by rows flagged instead, on Flagged, not priced.
